ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central region across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the entire trailing edge and lateral margins. A vertical dark pixel cluster is centered at the base of the median notch, with secondary dark vertical streaks localized in the lower third of the fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) occur continuously along the trailing edge boundary; the most pronounced pixel variations are located at the lateral-most margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a complex curve, beginning with a concave sweep from the notch before transitioning into a convex curve towards the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast dark pixels are concentrated at the terminal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, elongated diagonal linear mark is visible on the mid-left lobe; a shorter, vertical linear disruption is located on the inner portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark mottling at the fluke base near the peduncle junction; small irregular indentations and chips along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: The dark pigmentation at the median notch base forms a distinctive, symmetrical vertical pillar-like shape.
